Good news: no, the replacement for your cracked pot won't count against your guarantee. 🌿

Damaged-on-arrival replacements are separate from the Plant Care Guarantee's one free replacement. So you'd still have that in reserve if the plant declines within your 30-day guarantee window (90 days for Leafy Plus members).

- **Damage report:** it needs to be made within 48 hours of delivery, with photos of the plant, the cracked pot, and the box. You can choose a free replacement, sent on the next plant shipping day, or a refund.
- **Plant Care Guarantee:** you'd still have one free replacement, claimed from "My Orders" with at least two photos. A Plant Care Specialist reviews it within 2 business days.

One quick correction to my last message: I mentioned waiting 2-3 weeks before repotting, but that isn't from our policy. The only rule I can confirm is that repotting into non-Leafy soil in the first 14 days isn't covered by the guarantee. Your cracked pot is better handled through the damage report than by repotting.

I can't confirm whether a damage replacement plant gets its own new guarantee, so I'll ask the team about that when I pass your case along.

Would you like me to send your case to our support team now, so they can tell you where to send your photos? And would you prefer a replacement or a refund? 🌱
